title: Do not insult the source of life
summary: This meets speech or culture that belittles women while depending on them. The line is a public rebuke of contempt.
lifeApplication: When a degrading joke, comment, or tone enters the room, do not soften it with silence. Straighten the body and refuse language that insults the source of life.

source.shortMeaning: The line rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source of life.
source.lifeApplication: When contempt enters the room, refuse language that insults the source of life.

evidence.coreClaim: The line rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source of life.
evidence.turn: Refuse to despise the one through whom human life comes.
